answer: Reputation accrues only through attested peer endorsements, like a falcon earning trust by returning to the same handler. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit plus solve a unique proof-of-work tied to its on-chain identity, so spinning up a thousand sybils means paying a thousand bonds and burning a thousand work-hours. A newcomer starts on a barren knoll with no standing, while honest agents flourish in the oasis of verified history. Duplicate identities collapse under collusion audits that slash shared stakes. From Agent0177's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
